instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Boutique hotel group operating 4 properties in historic city centers with a combined 180 rooms. Focus is on experiential luxury with in-house curated culinary programs and cultural immersion packages. The group currently relies heavily on manual operations, meaning operational efficiency improvements are often driven by immediate guest satisfaction needs.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have never run a formal innovation initiative. Problems are solved ad-hoc as they arise, usually by the most directly affected team member. There is no dedicated budget, no structured ideation process, and no track record of experimenting with new technologies or business models beyond basic operational necessity.
answers.strategicGoals: We aim to double revenue within 3 years by entering 2 new geographic markets and launching a direct-to-consumer channel alongside our existing B2B distribution. Our top priority is identifying scalable customer acquisition channels and building the operational capacity to support rapid volume growth without degrading quality or margins.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role—innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.
answers.additionalContext: The team is highly motivated but lacks standardized metrics for measuring the success of any change. Current technology stack is legacy-based and requires significant modernization to support advanced personalization features.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized AI Pricing Engine (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: To achieve rapid growth and capture new markets, Apex needs to move beyond static pricing. Implementing a sophisticated machine learning model that dynamically adjusts room rates in real-time based on competitor availability, local events, guest demographics, and day-of-week demand would unlock significant revenue potential.

first_actions: Conduct vendor evaluation for specialized dynamic pricing software.
Pilot the algorithm on one property's booking system (low-risk environment).
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in RevPAR by 20% within 6 months
milestones: Q1: Platform selection and proof of concept.
Q2: Full property rollout and performance review.

opportunities.title: Integrated Guest Experience CRM Upgrade (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Since the current system is legacy, upgrading to a modern CRM that integrates dining preferences, cultural immersion interests, and direct booking history would allow for targeted marketing campaigns. This addresses customer feedback needs without requiring full digital overhaul.

first_actions: Select SaaS CRM solution with existing API compatibility.
Train current generalist developers on the new platform.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in repeat guest bookings by 15% within 4 months
milestones: Q1: CRM implementation and data migration.

opportunities.title: B2C Micro-Niche Digital Acquisition (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: To meet the goal of launching a DTC channel, Apex should focus on highly targeted digital content marketing rather than broad advertising. This involves developing specific experiential packages marketed through social media influencers and niche travel blogs relevant to luxury cultural immersion.

first_actions: Allocate 5% of the budget for influencer outreach campaign.
Develop a core content hub focusing on unique culinary experiences.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 50 direct bookings per month within 9 months

next_steps.action: Form a Lean Innovation Task Force
Finalize selection and contract for AI Pricing Platform pilot.
Establish basic KPIs for the new CRM to measure personalization success.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formal innovation process leading to reactive, unstructured problem-solving.
Zero dedicated budget for R&D or innovation initiatives (only 21% operational spend).
High dependency on owner/single decision-maker, which risks stifling cross-functional input.
Low digital maturity requiring a complete overhaul of legacy backend systems to support growth.
